piece.headline: ARORA STRETCHES CLEAR AS HAALAND FLOPS
piece.standfirst: Haaland blanked on 76 armbands, yet the leader still grew his lead. Kartik took the week.
piece.big_picture: Another Haaland blank, and still Rajat Arora pulled further clear. 4 weeks on top and the lead is now 18. Neol keeps second, but the chasing pack is not closing. Arora keeps getting free runs.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Swapnil picked the wrong 11 and the bench ate a big chunk of a good week. Imagine the score if the right players had started.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap holds the last big-prize place, with Cherag just 2 points behind. If Cherag's bench stops biting, the spot could change hands in a single week.

winners.name: Kartik
winners.verdict: Brought in N.Jackson and handed him the armband. Best week of his season, and still only 100th. Proper skill, and a long way left to climb.

winners.name: Sahil
winners.verdict: Bought Vuskovic just before he scored. Jumped from 42nd to 19th, a week after a wobble. Good call, with a bit of luck on top.

winners.name: Sidharth
winners.verdict: Third week running above average, with Gabriel as captain. Rocket winner, climbing 26 places in a week. That is a run, not a fluke.

losers.name: Janit
losers.verdict: 5 weeks running below average. Tough run, and the week's lowest score stings. Better days could be close.

losers.name: Vivek
losers.verdict: 4 weeks below average, and the worst week of the season. The slide down the table has become a landslide.

losers.name: Hardik
losers.verdict: Fell from 29th to 52nd, the worst week of the season and a Free Fall award. A sharp drop for a manager who had been steady.
